title: Platform Engineer
description:
Saltmarsh Cloud runs data centres on geothermal power. The platform team writes Python tools and runs Docker workloads.

Requirements: 2+ years of Python, Docker, and Linux.

This role is on-site in Reykjavik only. We do not offer remote work. We do not offer relocation help, and you must already live within commuting distance of the Reykjavik office.
